title: Simply one of the most...
text: Simply one of the most incredible places to visit. Tickets arrived with plenty of time before the booking and questions answered promptly. Would recommend the service of you left it too late to buy the tickets for much cheaper on the website!
author: Benn_C

title: A must see!
text:
After seeing so many negative reviews about the price, I felt I had to share my experience.

I hadn’t booked tickets in advance, and it was only a few days before my trip that I realized I actually needed to reserve them. The Alhambra is an incredibly popular attraction, and tickets on the official website sell out weeks in advance. And the Nasrid Palaces are an absolute must-see!

So I was extremely happy to find tickets available on Viator. Yes, the price was a bit higher, but trust me, it was absolutely worth it! The Alhambra, and especially the Nasrid Palaces, turned out to be the largest
